products.name: Custom Pet Portrait Hoop
products.story: Your pet, in thread. Our artist sketches their face from your photo, matches the thread to their fur shade by shade, and stitches every whisker in a wooden hoop.

why.title: Sketch first
why.text: You approve a pencil sketch before we stitch

why.title: Fur-matched
why.text: Up to 14 thread shades per portrait

spec.label: Approval
spec.value: Pencil sketch on WhatsApp within 48 hours

care: Dust with a soft, dry brush

faq.q: What kind of photo works best?
faq.a: A sharp, well-lit photo taken at your pet’s eye level, with both eyes clearly visible. Daylight from a window is perfect. You can send up to 3 photos on WhatsApp.

faq.q: Can you stitch two pets in one hoop?
faq.a: Yes, in the 10" hoop. WhatsApp us both photos before you order and we’ll confirm the price.

upClose.caption: Hundreds of tiny straight stitches in up to 14 shades build the fur, one layer at a time.
